⚡ BetterDt-Trainer

For Devices Tycoon

A feature-rich trainer mod for Devices Tycoon, built on top of the BetterDT framework. Effortlessly manage your in-game budget, research points, and visual themes with a modern glass-morphism interface.

💰 Money Hack

Add +$10,000,000 or +$1,000,000,000 instantly to your budget.

🔬 Research Points

Get +100,000 RP to fast-track your technology unlocks.

🎨 Custom Themes

Switch between Gold, Neon Blue, and Dark visual styles.

⚙️ UI & Keybinds

Toggle panel via F4 / Insert, adjust screen placement & settings.
